title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero degrees for all axes and a translation vector of [0.5109, 0.0939, 0.0]. Begin by drawing a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. In the first loop, start with the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.2344, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.2344, 0.0) to (0.2344, 0.0656). Continue with the third line from (0.2344, 0.0656) to (0.1828, 0.0656), followed by the fourth line from (0.1828, 0.0656) to (0.1828, 0.0563). Add the fifth line from (0.1828, 0.0563) to (0.225, 0.0563), and the sixth line from (0.225, 0.0563) to (0.225, 0.0094). Draw the seventh line from (0.225, 0.0094) to (0.1219, 0.0094), and the eighth line from (0.1219, 0.0094) to (0.1219, 0.0656). Continue with the ninth line from (0.1219, 0.0656) to (0.1125, 0.0656), and the tenth line from (0.1125, 0.0656) to (0.1125, 0.0094). Add the eleventh line from (0.1125, 0.0094) to (0.0094, 0.0094), and the twelfth line from (0.0094, 0.0094) to (0.0094, 0.1125). Finally, draw the thirteenth line from (0.0094, 0.1125) to (0.0, 0.1125), and the fourteenth line from (0.0, 0.1125) back to the origin (0.0, 0.0). Scale the entire sketch by a factor of 0.2344. Transform the scaled sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and translating it using the vector [0.5109, 0.0939, 0.0]. Extrude the sketch 0.1031 units along the normal direction to create a new solid body. The resulting part, named the L-shaped CAD model, has a length of 0.234375 units, a width of 0.1125 units, and a height of 0.103125 units. The shape features a rectangular base with a vertical extension, forming a 90-degree angle at the top.

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall bounding box: X=0.2344, Y=0.1125, Z=0.1031
# The part is a uniform-height (Z) extrusion of a thin-walled profile in XY:
#  - a full-length base slab (thin in Y, spans all X, full Z height)
#  - a tall left wall (thin in X, spans full Y depth)
#  - a mid-height middle wall (thin in X, partial Y depth)
#  - a right wall (thin in X, partial Y depth) with a top flange hooking inward

t = 0.0056          # wall thickness
H = 0.1031          # extrusion height (Z)
LX = 0.2344         # total X
LY = 0.1125         # total Y
WH = 0.0670         # height (Y-extent) of middle/right walls
FL_Y0 = 0.0614      # bottom of top flange


def slab(x0, y0, dx, dy):
    return (cq.Workplane("XY")
            .center(x0 + dx / 2.0, y0 + dy / 2.0)
            .rect(dx, dy)
            .extrude(H))


# Base slab: full X length, thin in Y, full height
base = slab(0.0, 0.0, LX, t)

# Left wall: full Y depth
left_wall = slab(0.0, 0.0, t, LY)

# Middle wall: partial depth
mid_wall = slab(0.1172, 0.0, t, WH)

# Right wall: partial depth
right_wall = slab(0.2288, 0.0, t, WH)

# Top flange: horizontal strip at wall-top level, hooking inward from right wall
flange = slab(0.1953, FL_Y0, LX - 0.1953, t)

r = base.union(left_wall).union(mid_wall).union(right_wall).union(flange)

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Grid unit suggested by the bounding box: X=25u, Y=12u, Z=11u
u = 0.009375
X = 0.2344
Y = 0.1125
Z = 0.1031

# Front rail running the full X length
r = cq.Workplane("XY").box(X, u, Z, centered=False)

# Left end wall, full Y depth
r = r.union(cq.Workplane("XY").box(u, Y, Z, centered=False))

# Intermediate rib
r = r.union(
    cq.Workplane("XY").box(u, 6 * u, Z, centered=False)
    .translate((11 * u, u, 0))
)

# Right end spine
r = r.union(
    cq.Workplane("XY").box(X - 24 * u, 7 * u, Z, centered=False)
    .translate((24 * u, 0, 0))
)

# Right end top arm, forming the C-shaped end pocket
r = r.union(
    cq.Workplane("XY").box(X - 19 * u, u, Z, centered=False)
    .translate((19 * u, 6 * u, 0))
)
